data.name: Banana Farm
targeting_extra: No attack; bananas spawn erratically in range, or spawn at set spot with x-x-3+ (Marketplace line spawns no collectibles)
data.crosspath_rule: Standard BTD6: one path to tier 5, a second path up to tier 2, third path locked at 0.

1.name: Banana Research Facility
1.text: Generates 5 crates per round worth $300 each instead of bunches.

1.name: Banana Central
1.text: Crate value $300->$1,200 ($6,000/round; wiki prose says $7,000, table says 6000); +25% income buff to all Banana Research Facilities on map.

2.name: Long Life Bananas
2.text: Banana lifespan 15->30s. No crosspath benefit for Marketplace+.

2.name: Valuable Bananas
2.text: All bananas +25% value ($25 each; +30% with More Valuable Bananas MK). Additive with income buffs (Monkey City +20%) but not Geraldo's Fertilizer.

2.name: Monkey Bank
2.text: Cash deposited in internal bank balance (withdraw anytime), +15% interest at round end; capacity $7,000 ($9,500 w/ Bigger Banks MK); stops producing when full. EZ Collect: glows when full. Banana Salvage: auto-collects when full.

2.name: IMF Loan
2.text: Bank capacity $10,000. Ability grants $9,000 and equal debt repaid over time; cd 85s, full initial cooldown, max 2 uses/round, disabled if round exceeds 3 min, not usable between rounds, not while previous loan unpaid. Bank Deposits MK: deposits accrue interest after 2 rounds.

2.name: Monkey-Nomics
2.text: Replaces IMF Loan with debt-free $9,000 ability; cd 60s, 2 uses/round, disabled if round >3 min, not usable between rounds. Boostable only by Monkey City buff.

3.name: EZ Collect
3.text: Magnet radius 50->75; uncollected expiring bananas auto-collect for 50% value. Banks glow when full.

3.name: Banana Salvage
3.text: Spoiled bananas auto-harvested for 85%; Banks auto-collect when full (with Monkey Bank+); sell value +10%.

3.name: Marketplace
3.text: Auto-generates 16 packets of $20 per round, no collectibles; Path1 T1/T2 each add +2 packets; Valuable Bananas packet $25 ($26 MK). Healthy Bananas MK: 1 life/round.

3.name: Central Market
3.text: Packet value $20->$70 ($1,120/round); Path1 upgrades +2 packets each; Valuable Bananas +25%/+30%. Each Central Market gives all Merchantmen +10% income, additive, max +100%. Healthy Bananas MK: 3 lives/round.

3.name: Monkey Wall Street
3.text: Adds $4,000 and 15 lives at end of each round (not affected by crosspath; Monkey City and Geraldo's Fertilizer apply). Auto-collects collectibles (bananas, Bloon traps, Supply Drop crates) in range; range 40->75.

data.paragon_note: No Banana Farm paragon on wiki.
